title: Alfie AI | The Intelligence Behind Your Browser
description: Meet the AI brain built for Alfie. Go beyond generic AI agents with an intelligence designed specifically to understand, navigate, and work alongside you through the Alfie extension. From filling forms to handling complex browser workflows, Alfie AI is optimized for efficient execution, better context retention, and fewer unnecessary token-consuming interactions. No one-size-fits-all agent. Just an AI built around the way Alfie works.
